GoalOptions.Label: Accelerate Adoption
GoalOptions.Text: Enable rapid and confident adoption of the AI-Assisted Code Review & Security Gate by the engineering team. Success means developers understand its value, integrate it seamlessly into their workflows, and actively utilize its feedback to improve code quality and security posture without significant friction.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Architectural Alignment
GoalOptions.Text: Guarantee that all development teams understand and adhere to the architectural principles underpinning the Event-Driven AI-Assisted Code Review solution. This ensures consistency, scalability, and maintainability across all integrations and future enhancements, preventing anti-patterns and ensuring robust system health.

GoalOptions.Label: Streamline Onboarding
GoalOptions.Text: Provide a comprehensive and self-sufficient resource for new developers to quickly understand, configure, and effectively use the AI-Assisted Code Review & Security Gate. Success is measured by a significant reduction in onboarding time and support requests related to the tool's integration and usage.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Security Posture
GoalOptions.Text: Educate developers on how the AI-Assisted Code Review & Security Gate directly contributes to a stronger organizational security posture by proactively identifying and suggesting fixes for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. The goal is to foster a security-first mindset and reduce the incidence of critical vulnerabilities reaching production.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Efficacy & Integration
Criteria: Document accurately describes the event-driven architecture and data flow of the AI analysis.
Integration steps for common SCM platforms (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) are clear and reproducible.
Explanation of LLM-powered static analysis capabilities (e.g., vulnerability detection, anti-pattern identification) is technically sound.
Guidance on interpreting AI-generated fix suggestions and security scores is unambiguous.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Readiness & Adoption
Criteria: The document clearly articulates the value proposition for developers (e.g., faster feedback, improved code quality).
Onboarding section allows a new developer to configure and run their first AI analysis within 30 minutes.
Common troubleshooting steps and FAQs are comprehensively addressed.
The document encourages proactive engagement with AI feedback, leading to measurable improvements in PR security scores over time.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Compliance & Risk Mitigation
Criteria: The document explicitly links the tool's capabilities to OWASP Top 10 vulnerability detection.
It outlines how the tool supports compliance with internal security policies and industry best practices.
Guidance is provided on handling false positives and escalating critical security findings.
The document reinforces the role of the AI gate as a critical layer in the overall CI/CD security strategy.
